sections.title: The Gameweek turning point
sections.text: My captain contribution: minus 2 points. Bench Defender had 7 on my unused bench. My team scored 40, but the score alone does not settle the next selection. Today I am reviewing the decisions behind the points, starting with the biggest returns.

sections.title: Gameweek in thirty seconds
sections.text: Before my own team, three returns stand out in the supplied data. Starting Hero scored 14 points. Forward Alternative scored 8 points. Keeper One scored 7 points. The complete league results are still pending, so these are the verified squad highlights. I am looking at routes to points and selection decisions. A strong score matters, but it does not automatically promise the same outcome next time. Let us look more closely at those three performances.

sections.title: My Gameweek story
sections.text: My total was 40, against an average of 40. Starting Hero was my best counted return, so that selection deserves credit. Bench Defender was my bench regret. Then there is the captaincy: minus 2 points counted. I can be honest about the frustration without changing every part of the team. The next lineup needs a better reason than simply reacting to the score.

sections.title: The full squad reveal
sections.text: Here is the verified starting eleven, with the bench kept separate. Keeper One in goal. Starting Defender, Starting Hero, Defender Two, Defender Three in defence. Midfielder One, Midfielder Two, Midfielder Three, Captain Mid in midfield. Forward Alternative, Forward Two up front. The armband follows the actual captain selection.
